score_bands.label: Exceptional Match
score_bands.description: Candidate demonstrates outstanding alignment with all core and preferred requirements.

score_bands.label: Strong Match
score_bands.description: Candidate satisfies all mandatory criteria with high relevant experience.

score_bands.label: Good Match
score_bands.description: Candidate meets primary qualifications with minor peripheral gaps.

score_bands.label: Moderate Match
score_bands.description: Partial skill alignment or some experience deficiency.

score_bands.label: Weak Match
score_bands.description: Notable gaps in required competencies or industry experience.

score_bands.label: Poor Match
score_bands.description: Significant shortfall across core mandatory requirements.
